description: Selection pressure at fleet scale: pick the ONE right device among 37 lookalikes and create a rule bound to it (not its zone sibling).

turns.user: coldroom-2 is running warm. Create a rule named coldroom2-warm: alert when coldroom-2's sensor 03 temperature exceeds 8 degrees Celsius.

per_turn: T1: `neomind rule create` bound to exactly device coldroom-2-sensor-03, metric temperature_c, threshold 8
expectations.overall: Rule coldroom2-warm exists AND references coldroom-2-sensor-03 (not any other sensor)
